soundtrack.music: Cinematic trailer energy turning into a driving beat: a deep boom, fast tense string ostinato, then a punchy hybrid drum groove with pulsing synth bass for the episode montage, big risers between episodes. Around 124 BPM, exciting and premium. Ends on a huge low hit. No vocals.

question.narration: Bu akşam ne izliyoruz? Yanlış soru. Doğru soru: Bu akşam ne çalışıyoruz?
